The incumbent is at the granted lower bound of both section scales, so a non-dominated point cannot come from reducing scale; the far-segment section scale is the directly analogous untested continuous axis. I change exactly one path per candidate (single-change, incumbent-relative) so each point is interpretable, hold robot, task, acceptance, controller implementation and all numerical settings fixed, and keep both control tip-speed weights frozen at 0.05/0.05 so there is zero control adaptation and all variation is structural. Method rationale: the explicit method evaluates my own ordered points with null step; two levels on one bounded coordinate give only a minimal dose-response, not a mathematical optimization, and no categorical material choice is interpolated. Expected information: whether far-segment stiffening can lower sampled holding speed without worsening terminal or holding position error; a joint pass with non-worsening metrics would be an eligible candidate for retention review, whereas a dominated pass or holding-speed failure closes this axis and directs the remaining untested paths (segments/near length, segments/far length, material scenarios). weakening_observations: The single changed near-section 0.96 execution on the perturbed near_z_plus case failed holding speed at 0.0676 m/s (execution 8b8ce269); it is case-confounded and weakens any prior that raising a bending section scale lowers holding speed.

The fresh near_section_scale ~1.00 point (execution 054cb6d5) was jointly accepted but strictly worse than the incumbent on all three sampled metrics (F415 0.003195 m, F360 0.003323 m, F350 0.013737 m/s versus 0.002698 m, 0.002730 m, 0.012750 m/s), so a structural scale increase is at least as likely to worsen as to improve.
Sampled holding speed is not monotone in the frozen weights, so a frozen-weight structural probe may land on a non-monotone response.
The incumbent already sits at the granted lower bound 0.95 of both section scales, so no downward structural scale move is available to recover position error.

interpretations.scope: Nominal case, seed 17, frozen offline_reach_hold_v1 acceptance, frozen timing/tolerances and stable controller.gvs_normpc@7.0.0; current campaign feedback only.
interpretations.statement: Outcome 0 (execution 054cb6d5) is a fresh, valid, jointly accepted nominal point (F414, F430, F460, F454) that is strictly dominated by the retained incumbent on every sampled physical metric: terminal_error_m 0.003195 m (F415), holding_max_error_m 0.003323 m (F360) and holding_max_speed_m_s 0.013737 m/s (F350) versus the incumbent's recorded 0.002698 m, 0.002730 m and 0.012750 m/s. Outcome 1 (execution dfb3b398) is a valid_failure (F501, F461, F325) whose sole failing component is sampled holding speed 0.054581 m/s (F482, F405); it changes more than one path, so it is confounded and says nothing about the unchanged incumbent.
interpretations.uncertainty: Identity-based incumbent comparison is classified unavailable because configuration identities differ, so the comparison above is descriptive against recorded incumbent metrics; one execution per configuration; no causal attribution and no continuous-time guarantee.

interpretations.scope: Executed in-scope evidence only; no population, seed-18, unseen-case, three-group or global-optimum claim.
interpretations.statement: No executed configuration in this scope is yet established as jointly accepted with all three sampled physical metrics non-worsening relative to the retained incumbent; tested deviations give dominated passes (F415/F360/F350) or holding-speed failures (F482). The granted structural region is therefore the highest-information affordable direction: near_section_scale has been probed upward (1.00 dominated pass, 1.05 confounded failure), while design/far_section_scale, components/near/length_m, components/far/length_m and both material scenarios remain untested on nominal.
interpretations.uncertainty: Untested points may be non-worsening, dominated or failing; the granted eight-variable catalog is not exhausted and local evidence cannot guarantee nonlinear reach, braking or perturbation robustness.

interpretations.scope: Recorded campaign control-weight points at the retained structure; descriptive association only.
interpretations.statement: Sampled holding speed at the frozen structure is not monotone in the frozen control tip-speed weights: higher holding penalties recorded higher sampled holding speed, and the one control-weight change that lowered holding speed did so while enlarging terminal and holding position error. Control-only adaptation therefore currently yields only trade-offs or failures, which motivates an isolated structural probe at frozen weights.
interpretations.uncertainty: Single executions, confounded representation differences between initializer records, and only two weight values per axis executed; no monotonicity, causality or continuous-time claim is made.
